Subject: Start: Evidence sweep & licensing schedule for Okta renewal

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for taking this on — we have your renewal coming up in mid-June and want to get an evidence sweep and licensing headcount confirmed so procurement can issue the renewal PO on time.

Attached is a short checklist we usually start with (SOC2 report, current admin list, API token inventory, device posture SSO config export). If you can share an internal owner for each item we’ll mark responsibilities and propose delivery dates.

High-level proposal:
- Week of Apr 26: internal inventory + API/token export
- Week of May 3: SOC2 and compliance evidence delivered to Okta portal (zip)
- Week of May 10: joint review, finalize SKU counts and pricing
- Mid-May: DocuSign PO to procurement

Who should I expect to be the day-to-day contact on evidence uploads? Also flag if you need us to provide a limited SFTP or secure upload link.

Thanks,
Claire Bennett
Client Success Manager — Okta Enterprise Sales

Claire — thanks, received.

Quick answers:
- Day-to-day: Neha (security compliance) will own the evidence upload and verification pipeline. Vivek will coordinate any infrastructure export (API keys, token rotation history, admin list). Laura will own PO review/approvals on the finance side.

We ran a quick inventory and attached a starter sheet with SKU owners and an initial headcount snapshot. Can you confirm whether we should include sandbox/test tenants in the SKU count or trim to production-only seats? Also we need a copy of Okta's most recent SOC2 Type II (date stamped) — if you can share that via your secure portal that would be ideal.

Proposed internal timeline (can compress if needed):
- Apr 26: Neha uploads admin list + API/token export to secure folder
- May 3: We push SOC2 + evidence bundle to Okta portal
- May 6: internal review, pricing confirmation meeting May 10

If that works, I’ll send a short mutual action plan (MAP) and a calendar invite for May 10.

Cheers,

Folks — looping in a concise MAP for visibility. I drafted the deliverables and owners; see attached. Key notes:

- We will not count sandbox seats toward production licensing unless they have active SSO linked to production IdPs. Device posture agents installed on dev machines should be noted but excluded unless enforced by policy.
- For SOC2, we need the last 12 months of evidence for the in-scope controls (not just the report). Okta commonly provides a secure bundle via their portal — Claire, confirmation of bundle content would help.
- Evidence transfer: we prefer S3 presigned URL or Okta SFTP; DO NOT send sensitive logs over standard email.

Next actions:
1) Claire to confirm portal bundle contents and set up an upload path (by Apr 27)
2) Vivek to export admin list + token inventory (by Apr 26)
3) Neha to validate and assemble the evidence bundle (by May 3)
4) Rachel/Laura to validate PO trigger and sign-off path (target May 6)

I’ll be on PTO Apr 28–30 but will monitor for critical items.

-Neha
Security Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP-draft-Okta-renewal.docx

- Regarding seats: we will send a SKU export that includes tenant flags. If a seat is active in production tenant we’ll mark it; otherwise we’ll annotate test/sandbox.
- Pricing sheet attached; note the SKU tiers change at the 1k and 5k seat thresholds.
